title: Centralizer Excess as an Obstruction to Carlson's Depth Conjecture
summary: Let $G=\operatorname{SmallGroup}(128,859)$ and $k=\overline{k}$. The cohomology ring $H^*(G;k)$ has depth two, and we prove that the minimum quotient dimension of an associated prime is exactly three. Okuyama's theorem shows that an integer $r$ occurs as such a dimension exactly when there is an elementary abelian subgroup $E\leq G$ of rank $r$ with $\operatorname{depth} H^*(C_G(E);k)=r$.
